title: Chapter 12: Local Self Government – Panchayati Raj and Municipalities

blocks.content: Part IX of the Constitution deals with Panchayats (Articles 243–243O) and Part IX-A deals with Municipalities (Articles 243P–243ZG).
Part IX of the Constitution deals with Panchayats (Articles 243–243O) and Part IX-A deals with Municipalities (Articles 243P–243ZG).

items: Remember that Panchayats fall under Part IX (Articles 243–243O).
Note that Municipalities fall under Part IX-A (Articles 243P–243ZG).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Part IX of the Constitution contains provisions regarding Panchayats.
Panchayat provisions are covered under Articles 243 through 243O.
Part IX-A of the Constitution deals specifically with Municipalities.
